title: Four horns and four craftsmen (second night vision)

symbols.in_text_interpretation: "The horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem" (1:19); "the horns of the nations" (1:21). The nations are not named.
They come "to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations" (1:21). Not identified.

description: Zechariah sees four horns, then four craftsmen who come to terrify and cast down the horns.
